executiveSummary.headline: Reconcile Event Totals and the Capital View Name
executiveSummary.lead: Renaissance Arlington Capital View leads its certified five-hotel set, but appears in only 54.3% of eligible scenarios and 19.0% of comparable consideration answers. Official pages verify a complimentary DCA, Metro, Pentagon, and Amazon HQ2 shuttle, SOCCi dining, Navigator programming, and substantial meetings inventory. The immediate work is to reconcile event totals and property naming, resolve conflicting pet fees, and organize those verified demand signals.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration is the share of comparable monitored answers mentioning the hotel; Scenario Presence is the share of eligible traveler-need scenarios where it appeared. Certified Peer Position uses only the named certified Marriott Bonvoy set. These measures do not represent bookings, ADR, revenue, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: Reconcile Event Totals and the Capital View Name
themes.what: The overview markets 17,000 square feet; the events summary reports 17,179; its opening copy says 20,000; and virtual-tour copy says “Renaissance Arlington Capitol View Hotel” rather than Capital View.
themes.whyItMatters: Planners need one inventory basis, and the property name should be consistent for entity clarity.

themes.title: Resolve Conflicting Pet-Fee Terms
themes.what: Pet-friendly marketing states a $100 non-refundable fee per stay, while hotel information and the FAQ state a $50 non-refundable fee per night; both allow up to two pets.
themes.whyItMatters: Guests need one approved fee basis before booking, and the audit cannot determine which amount is current.

themes.title: Strengthen Shuttle, Dining, Navigator, and Demand Context
themes.what: Marriott verifies complimentary scheduled service to DCA and Crystal City Metro plus weekday Pentagon/Amazon HQ2 service, SOCCi, illy Café, room service, Renaissance Navigators, and government/military positioning. ADP recorded 0% recognition for airport shuttle, restaurant, room service, ballroom capacity, and Navigator.
themes.whyItMatters: These facts support airport, government, corporate, and local-experience decisions, but no ranking or booking causation is claimed.
